core_concern.description: Core {object_of_study} expressed per coding style or verb phrase.

rationale.description: Qualitative reasoning connecting the 3 questions. Cite specific codes.

recurring_problems.description: Recurring {object_of_study}s identified (Question 1). Empty array if none identified.

resolving_mechanisms.description: Codes or mechanisms that {processing_verb} the pattern (Question 2). Empty array if none identified.

most_connected_codes.description: Codes with highest centrality and explanatory power (Question 3). Empty array if none identified.

alternative_concerns.description: Plausible alternative patterns if confidence is not HIGH.

why_less_likely.description: Why it is less likely than the main one.

no_clear_concern.description: true if the data does not support a clear {object_of_study}.

no_concern_rationale.description: If no_clear_concern=true: what is missing in the data to identify a {object_of_study}.

relevant_population_dimensions.description: Population dimensions relevant for understanding how this {object_of_study} manifests. Derived from A1 and prime movers. MOMENT 1 of variable emergence.
